nodes.Name: initMetrics
nodes.DocComment:
initMetrics initializes the metrics map if it hasn't been yet.

metricsSema must be held.

nodes.Name: godebug_registerMetric
nodes.DocComment: go:linkname godebug_registerMetric internal/godebug.registerMetric

nodes.Name: statDep
nodes.DocComment:
statDep is a dependency on a group of statistics
that a metric might have.

nodes.Name: statDepSet
nodes.DocComment:
statDepSet represents a set of statDeps.

Under the hood, it's a bitmap.

nodes.Name: makeStatDepSet
nodes.DocComment: makeStatDepSet creates a new statDepSet from a list of statDeps.

nodes.Name: difference
nodes.DocComment: difference returns set difference of s from b as a new set.

nodes.Name: union
nodes.DocComment: union returns the union of the two sets as a new set.

nodes.Name: empty
nodes.DocComment: empty returns true if there are no dependencies in the set.

nodes.Name: has
nodes.DocComment: has returns true if the set contains a given statDep.

nodes.Name: heapStatsAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
heapStatsAggregate represents memory stats obtained from the
runtime. This set of stats is grouped together because they
depend on each other in some way to make sense of the runtime's
current heap memory use. They're also sharded across Ps, so it
makes sense to grab them all at once.

nodes.Name: compute
nodes.DocComment: compute populates the heapStatsAggregate with values from the runtime.

nodes.Name: sysStatsAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
sysStatsAggregate represents system memory stats obtained
from the runtime. This set of stats is grouped together because
they're all relatively cheap to acquire and generally independent
of one another and other runtime memory stats. The fact that they
may be acquired at different times, especially with respect to
heapStatsAggregate, means there could be some skew, but because of
these stats are independent, there's no real consistency issue here.

nodes.Name: compute
nodes.DocComment: compute populates the sysStatsAggregate with values from the runtime.

nodes.Name: cpuStatsAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
cpuStatsAggregate represents CPU stats obtained from the runtime
acquired together to avoid skew and inconsistencies.

nodes.Name: compute
nodes.DocComment: compute populates the cpuStatsAggregate with values from the runtime.

nodes.Name: gcStatsAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
gcStatsAggregate represents various GC stats obtained from the runtime
acquired together to avoid skew and inconsistencies.

nodes.Name: compute
nodes.DocComment: compute populates the gcStatsAggregate with values from the runtime.

nodes.Name: finalStatsAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
finalStatsAggregate represents various finalizer/cleanup stats obtained
from the runtime acquired together to avoid skew and inconsistencies.

nodes.Name: compute
nodes.DocComment: compute populates the finalStatsAggregate with values from the runtime.

nodes.Name: schedStatsAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
schedStatsAggregate contains stats about the scheduler, including
an approximate count of goroutines in each state.

nodes.Name: compute
nodes.DocComment: compute populates the schedStatsAggregate with values from the runtime.

nodes.Name: nsToSec
nodes.DocComment:
nsToSec takes a duration in nanoseconds and converts it to seconds as
a float64.

nodes.Name: statAggregate
nodes.DocComment:
statAggregate is the main driver of the metrics implementation.

It contains multiple aggregates of runtime statistics, as well
as a set of these aggregates that it has populated. The aggregates
are populated lazily by its ensure method.

nodes.Name: ensure
nodes.DocComment:
ensure populates statistics aggregates determined by deps if they
haven't yet been populated.

nodes.Name: metricKind
nodes.DocComment:
metricKind is a runtime copy of runtime/metrics.ValueKind and
must be kept structurally identical to that type.

nodes.Name: metricSample
nodes.DocComment:
metricSample is a runtime copy of runtime/metrics.Sample and
must be kept structurally identical to that type.

nodes.Name: metricValue
nodes.DocComment:
metricValue is a runtime copy of runtime/metrics.Sample and
must be kept structurally identical to that type.

Fields.Name: scalar
Fields.DocComment: contains scalar values for scalar Kinds.

nodes.Name: float64HistOrInit
nodes.DocComment:
float64HistOrInit tries to pull out an existing float64Histogram
from the value, but if none exists, then it allocates one with
the given buckets.

nodes.Name: metricFloat64Histogram
nodes.DocComment:
metricFloat64Histogram is a runtime copy of runtime/metrics.Float64Histogram
and must be kept structurally identical to that type.

nodes.Name: agg
nodes.DocComment:
agg is used by readMetrics, and is protected by metricsSema.

Managed as a global variable because its pointer will be
an argument to a dynamically-defined function, and we'd
like to avoid it escaping to the heap.

nodes.Name: readMetricNames
nodes.DocComment:
readMetricNames is the implementation of runtime/metrics.readMetricNames,
used by the runtime/metrics test and otherwise unreferenced.

go:linkname readMetricNames runtime/metrics_test.runtime_readMetricNames

nodes.Name: readMetrics
nodes.DocComment:
readMetrics is the implementation of runtime/metrics.Read.

go:linkname readMetrics runtime/metrics.runtime_readMetrics

nodes.Name: readMetricsLocked
nodes.DocComment:
readMetricsLocked is the internal, locked portion of readMetrics.

Broken out for more robust testing. metricsLock must be held and
initMetrics must have been called already.
